# Interior trim removal procedures

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Remove all plastic panels, interior lights, and push-pop handles located in the center. [t938]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove all plastic panels from the front to back of the vehicle.
2. [Partial] Take off interior lights and push-pop handles located in the center.

_Procedure reported by [t938]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Have two people work together to handle the fabric safely without creasing it. [t938]

## Common mistakes

- Pulling the headliner down too far and risking a permanent crease or tear. [t938]
- Forgetting that some clips are hidden under roof cross members and can break if not pulled correctly. [t938]
